name: Kitajima Mia
source:
A newly hired office lady working at the Matsunami Branch of Ninmori Trading Company.

She is shy and reserved, but highly competent at her job.

After Kensuke kindly helped her with her work, she gradually developed romantic feelings for him.

She is petite, with a childlike figure, and has the sort of appearance that makes people want to protect her.

Her hobbies include collecting stationery and preparing tea for others. She sometimes brings homemade sweets to serve as refreshments during tea breaks.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
